verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL docs say users can inspect a query's execution plan to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities. They also say the product gives automatic insights and recommendations when queries run inefficiently, which covers the core of diagnosing slow queries. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of query profile metrics (operator-level time, rows, spill), evidence of per-query cost attribution for 'expensive' queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond one-line doc claims.
